dataGroupsAreEmptyBecause: dataGroups is empty on purpose, and this is the reason (#62). It lives in appData because the
schema sets additionalProperties: false, so there is no comment key to put it in.
Portal cached five /api/** paths with strategy 'freshness' because it had no offline store.
ADR-0004 replaced that with IndexedDB, an ordered outbox and a shared fold, so a service-worker
cache over the API is now a second, dumber copy with no fold and no sequence.
Worse: ngsw caches GET, and the resync path is a GET. A stale cached snapshot hands the client a
stale sequence watermark, so the stream resumes from the wrong point and the patches in the gap
are lost permanently and invisibly - the ?since= defect ADR-0004 was written to kill,
reintroduced by configuration instead of by code.
Offline reads come from IndexedDB. Nothing here. See src/app/pwa/ngsw-config.spec.ts.
navigationUrlsAreNarrowedBecause: ngsw answers any navigation request matching navigationUrls with index.html, and the default
list is 'everything without a dot in the last segment'. ADR-0010 puts Keycloak on this same
origin under /realms, so the redirect to the login page matched it and was served the app
instead. In the silent check-sso iframe that app booted, asked for a token, opened another
iframe, and the tab looped for ever - logging in was impossible with a worker installed.
Found end to end by #64, which is the only thing in the stack that could see it: the build is
green either way and ng serve installs no worker.
